messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT: 5xx error rate spike on /v1/generate (us-west) — threshold 5% breached. Runbook: https://rwd/repo/runbooks/upstream-502. Paged eng-oncall.

alex: Oncall alex here. Seeing 6.7% 5xx over 5m, short bursts to 12% for embeddings route. Starting triage.

sam: Logs show repeated upstream read timeouts from gpu-cache-us-west: `502 upstream read timeout`. Sample:
```
proxy: upstream read timeout id=0x1234 pool=gpu-cache-us-west backend=10.0.4.2 status=502 latency=2.11s
```

alex: Looks like gpu-cache is flaking. I'll divert non-critical traffic to fallback pool and scale down some hungry jobs.

jules: Any known deploys/maintenance? Could be autoscaler churn causing connection storms.

sam: No deploys in last 30m. Autoscaler schedule had a couple nodes come up ~10m ago.

alex: Running: `infra scale-pool --pool=gpu-cache-us-west --delta=-2` and `routing update --route=embeddings --fallback=eu-west` — applying now.

deploy-bot: Routing policy updated: embeddings -> fallback eu-west for burst mitigation. :white_check_mark:

maria: Recommend temp upstream timeout bump 2s -> 6s for gpu-cache to avoid client-visible 502s while nodes warm.

alex: Applied timeout change via feature-flag for gpu-cache-us-west. Monitoring.

sam: 5xx dropped to ~2.1% in the last 2m. Good improvement.

jules: For post-incident: propose alert tuning: add 10m window + 3m smoothing, splay alerts to avoid pager floods, and add a dashboard panel: `upstream_timeout_rate{pool} by pool`.

alex: Agreed. Also add suppression rule for autoscaler events to avoid noisy pages.

maria: I'll open a PR for: alert change, dashboard panel, and runtime config for timeout. Assigning to myself. PR will include queries and suggested thresholds.

alex: Thanks. I'll document mitigation steps and link logs in the incident doc. @nina I'll hand this to you for morning watch. Current status: nominal, continuing monitoring. :eyes:

oncall-bot: Handoff recorded from alex to nina. Summary: upstream timeouts caused 5xx spike -> traffic diverted, timeout increased, 5xx rate back under threshold. Follow-ups created.

nina: Acknowledged, will pick up in AM and validate dashboard + PR.

alex: Closing active pager. If anything spikes, re-open the thread. :white_check_mark:
